name: shannah/xataface-module-excel
description: Xataface Excel export module. Uses PhpSpreadsheet on PHP 7.2+, falls back to the bundled PHPExcel 1.7.9 on older PHP.

suggest.phpoffice/phpspreadsheet: Required on PHP >= 8.0; recommended on PHP >= 7.2. The bundled lib/PHPExcel is used only when PhpSpreadsheet is unavailable.
